'''Crystal paddlefish''' are food obtained within the [[Gauntlet]], healing 16 [[Hitpoints]]. Like [[cooked karambwan]], they can be eaten instantly with no delay after eating a paddlefish.

It can be made with 10 [[Crystal shards (The Gauntlet)|crystal shards]] and a [[paddlefish]] at the [[Singing Bowl (The Gauntlet)|singing bowl]].
